note: Recovered from the commissioner's mailbox, read only. Each entry is a paraphrase, never a quotation, and cites its source by date and subject, never by sender. Entries with an 'evidence' field have been checked against the MFL archive. The mailbox reaches back to about 2011, so the 2005 to 2012 gaps are not here.

entries.evidence: League scoring rises from 78.3 points a team-game in 2017 to 116.5 in 2018 (datasets/season_scoring.csv).

entries.proposal: Draft clock of 2 minutes per pick for the whole draft, with one 2-minute timeout per franchise. A team that runs out of time is skipped and picks after the next team.
Two alternatives to divisions: everyone plays everyone once in weeks 1 to 15 with the top two meeting in week 16; or each team plays 13 of 15 opponents with an 8-team playoff from week 14.

COVID plan. If the NFL completes 0 to 6 games: fees refunded less website costs, next season's retainment values frozen, 15 retainment slots with rookies counting as one, and draft order weighted-random within picks 1 to 8 and 9 to 16. If 7 or more games are played but the season stops before the playoffs: the season counts, ranked by MFL all-play record (then points, then coin flip), and retainment values come from points per game. If it stops during the playoffs: seeded in three groups (non-playoff, eliminated, still alive) by all-play record, draft order the inverse of finish.
A COVID reserve list: players MFL designates as opted out or out with COVID may sit there without counting against the 20-man roster, and must return to it or be dropped when the designation ends.
entries.evidence: MFL shows 5 reserve slots in 2020 and none before or after (2026 has 1).
